title: Learnly
summary: Online courses with lessons, quizzes, progress and certificates.
description: Students enrol, read lessons, take quizzes and earn a certificate; instructors build courses and see scores. A rule allows three quiz attempts, completing a course fires a workflow, and an AI hint helps without giving the answer away.
roles_summary: Students sign up. Instructors build courses.
highlights: Rule: three quiz attempts at most
AI hint that doesn't give away the answer
